title: The Internet Lives On The Ocean Floor
hook: The internet lives on *the ocean floor*

scenes.text: The internet is not in the sky.

Over ninety nine percent of data between continents travels through cables on the ocean floor. Some are about as thick as a garden hose. Hundreds of them carry your messages, your money, your video calls. Every year, well over a hundred are damaged, mostly by ship anchors and fishing nets.
Governments now treat them as strategic targets.
Your digital life hangs on wires in the dark. Because...
